name: Blood Amulet

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Three charges (1d3 back at dawn): when you deal damage, a charge adds 2d10 Necrotic and a Constitution save against Exhaustion.
text: This amulet has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges each dawn. When you damage a creature while wearing it, you can spend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 Necrotic damage to it; the creature then makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gains a level of Exhaustion. In a fight you ready it (no action) and the next damage you deal uses it.

powers.name: Ready the Amulet
powers.text: Your next damage to a creature spends a charge: +2d10 Necrotic and a DC 15 Con save or a level of Exhaustion.
